ReleaseNotes: Improved Site Dashboard Parent Database cache refresh reliability and automatic retry handling.
Improved Parent Database connection handling during temporary connectivity issues.
Reduced unnecessary Dispatch Tickets refreshes while typing in search.
Administration Technicians are now sorted alphabetically by first name.
Improved Windows taskbar integration to prevent duplicate Smart Grid Suite icons.
Added 'Forget Client' in Connected Clients for old PCs.
Reworked Tower Equipment to show Base Station and Duplexer only.
Updated Tower pings to match MR/IGSD ping behavior, including continuous and counted ping modes.
Fixed Tower ping/test colors so status remains visible during hover and active pings.
Added editable Tower IP overrides for field diagnostics.
Added Open buttons to launch Tower IPs directly over HTTPS.
Fixed Tower pings so they continue running when switching between Site Dashboard tabs and restore their results when returning.
